spark_open.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal chimera standing in side profile on a small patch of dry ground with sparse grass, facing to the right with its head turned slightly toward the viewer. Its front half, including the head, neck, chest, and wings, is covered in dense, overlapping brown feathers like a bird of prey, while its torso, hindquarters, and four limbs are covered in short tan fur like a large cat. It has two large outspread wings on its upper back, four sturdy legs ending in clawed paws, and a long slender tail with a dark tuft at the tip. The overall coloration is warm brown and tan with darker brown shading on the wing flight feathers and tail tip.

meta_spark.description: A large four-legged creature standing in side view facing right on a small patch of bare dirt with sparse grass. The front has the head, hooked beak, and densely feathered neck and chest of a large bird of prey in golden-brown tones, with two large outspread feathered wings rising from the shoulders. The mid-body, four muscular legs, broad paws with claws, and long tuft-tipped tail are covered in short smooth tawny fur like a big cat. The overall color is golden-brown on the feathered front grading to light tan on the furred legs and body, with darker brown flight feathers and tail tuft.
